CustomField.description: Evaluates whether the custom file uploader LWC should be visible based on record type.
CustomField.formula: IF( CASE(RecordType.Name, "AV Meeting (with speaker)", 1, "AV Meeting (Without Speaker)", 1, "Business Meal", 1, "Enlisting Fees/Visiting Cards Fees/Other Fees", 1, "HCP educational support in international Congress", 1, "HCP educational support in National Congress", 1, "Hospital /3rd Party Scientific Event Sponsorship", 1, "Items of Medical / Educational Utility", 1, "Marketing Lead Activities", 1, "Medical Lead Non-Promotional Activities", 1, "Non Promotional", 1, "Opportunity Meeting", 1, "Promotional – CHC", 1, "Promotional – Primary Care", 1, "Promotional – Specialty", 1, "Significant Life Event", 1, 0 ) == 1, true, false )
CustomField.label: Show Custom File Uploader
